title: Iterative Constructions and Private Data Release
evidence_note: Pure-DP graph cut-query synthetic release with O(n^1.5/epsilon) additive error; historical open problem, theory-only, with interactive release distinguished from synthetic output.

title: Breaking the n^1.5 Additive Error Barrier for Private and Efficient Graph Sparsification via Private Expander Decomposition
evidence_note: Approximate-DP polynomial-time sparse synthetic graph with multiplicative 1+gamma plus n^(1.25+o(1)) additive error; not same guarantee as the 2011 pure-DP additive result.
